description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 18 (Ecological enhancement scheme) of planning permission reference 43495/APP/2020/888 dated 26.01.2022 (Demolition of existing building and the erection of a part four and part five storey block providing 34 residential units (Use Class C3); associated access and other works including landscaping and amenity space, car and cycle parking and refuse storage) as amended under 43495/APP/2023/1669 dated 05.07.2023
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The applicant/developer is advised that access to or any works on over or under land/waterspace (including oversailing) within the ownership of the Canal & River Trust will require a separate agreement with the Trust. Works should also comply with the Canal & River Trust "Code of Practice for Works affecting the Canal & River Trust". Further details can be found via the Trust's website. Please contact the Trust's infrastructure Works team to discuss these matters further. (enquiries.TPWSouth@canalriertrust.org.uk)
